name: Selzee AI Chat
author: selzeeai

sections.description:
Bring the Selzee conversational assistant to your WordPress site. The plugin connects WordPress to your Selzee dashboard so you can deploy the same chatbot experience visitors already enjoy elsewhere.

  • Authenticate with your Selzee dashboard in a few clicks.
  • Paste your chatbot UUID, toggle the embed, and go live.
  • Ship updates from Selzee without redeploying code.

License

Selzee AI Chat is distributed under the GPLv2 or later. All bundled assets, including assets/selzee-logo.png, are owned by Selzee and released under the same license for plugin distribution.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the selzee-ai-chat folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install via the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Selzee → Selzee AI Chat in the dashboard menu.
  4. Paste the chatbot ID from your Selzee dashboard and click Save changes.
  5. Toggle Enable to load the script on the frontend.
sections.faq:
Where can I find my chatbot ID?

Open the Selzee dashboard, select your chatbot, and copy the UUID that appears in the “Install” panel.

Does the plugin load assets on every page?

Yes. Once enabled, the embed script is injected in wp_head on all public pages so the chat icon is available to every visitor.
